facts.text: John won a basketball game by a tight score, and scoring the last basket with the crowd cheering was an awesome experience.

evidence.quote: Last week I had a crazy game - crazy intense! We won it by a tight score. Scoring that last basket and hearing the crowd cheer was awesome!
Winning a tough game must have been such an exhilarating experience!

facts.text: John only captured one photo of the basketball game, which he shared with Tim.

evidence.quote: Did you manage to capture any other photos from the game?
It was an amazing rush and just the one I showed you.

facts.text: Tim mentioned reconnecting with John after a long time and shared that he had a great time talking to a Harry Potter fan in California.

evidence.quote: Hey John! Long time no see! Been super busy lately. Guess what? Just skyped with that Harry Potter fan I met in CA and had a great time.
